# VendID MRZ API and Passport SDK: examples and reference

> Passport and ID card MRZ scanning for developers, by VendID (Späti to GO KG, Vienna, Austria). `POST https://vend-id.com/v1/mrz` with an image returns the machine-readable zone as JSON with every ICAO 9303 check digit verified; `mrz.js` adds a camera scanner to any web form with one script tag. EU servers, nothing stored. Free key in 60 seconds: 500 scans a month free (the free plan stops at 500 with HTTP 429, never a bill); Pay as you go €0.01 a scan; Starter €29 a month incl. 5,000. On-device SDK (browser €99/month or €990/year per website; mobile €990/year per app with NFC chip + Passive Authentication, €1,990 with face + liveness). This repository: MIT examples, API reference, OpenAPI, MCP server.

⚠ Free / development tier cold start: the engine scales to zero when idle, so the first request after a quiet spell takes ~7–10 s (warm-up), then ~0.5 s; warm ~15 min after the last request. Call `POST https://vend-id.com/v1/warmup` (same Bearer key, free) when the page opens; client timeout ≥ 30 s. Paid plans: always warm.

Everything an AI assistant needs in one file (auth, every error, full mrz.js API, recipes for HTML, React, Vue, Next.js, Node, Python, PHP, curl, WebViews, field mapping for SES.Hospedajes, Alloggiati Web, SIBA, migration from BlinkID / Regula / Scanbot / Dynamsoft): https://vend-id.com/llms-full.txt

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the shortest correct path to add passport scanning, facts to get right, prices
- [API reference](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/blob/main/docs/api.md): request, response fields, error codes, limits, mrz.js
- [JSON Schema of the response](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/blob/main/docs/response.schema.json)
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/main/openapi/openapi.yaml) · [Postman collection](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/blob/main/openapi/vendid-mrz-api.postman_collection.json)
- [Docs on vend-id.com](https://vend-id.com/sdk/docs) · [Markdown](https://vend-id.com/sdk/docs.md) · [Site index for LLMs](https://vend-id.com/llms.txt)

## Examples (MIT)

- [Web check-in form](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/tree/main/examples/web-checkin): camera, upload, specimen · [live](https://kaza.github.io/vendid-passport-sdk/examples/web-checkin/)
- [Node 18+](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/blob/main/examples/node/scan.mjs) · [Python](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/blob/main/examples/python/scan.py) · [curl](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/blob/main/examples/curl/scan.sh)
- [ICAO specimen passport](https://vend-id.com/sdk/specimen.jpg): free, never counted

## MCP server

- [mcp/](https://github.com/kaza/vendid-passport-sdk/tree/main/mcp): stdio server with `scan_mrz` (image path or base64), `get_pricing`, `get_docs(topic)`; install for Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients
